verdict.rationale: Square ships an official MCP server (square-docs-14, square-probe-4) that exposes its APIs to AI agents, enabling natural-language-driven operations (payments, catalog, orders, etc.) through an LLM client rather than a native command interface in the product itself. Missing for 10: no evidence of a built-in NL/chat interface inside Square's own dashboard or apps, no independent/hands-on validation of the MCP server's reliability, and no detail on which operations are actually exposed via MCP.
